issue.title: [Backend] Article offset skips the wrong number of records
issue.body:
## Summary
The articles endpoint treats the offset query parameter as a page number instead of the number of records to skip.

Agent base branch: `demo/replay-backend-bug`

## Reproduction steps
Run `Set-Location target-app; npm test -- --run backend/helper/pagination.test.js` and observe the failure for limit=10 and offset=20.

## Expected behavior
The query uses offset 20.

## Actual behavior
The query uses offset 200.

## Environment
Local target app test suite.
